title: A Concise Introduction to Quantum Electromagnetics
abstract: This book introduces quantum electromagnetics to readers trained in classical electromagnetics, without assuming a systematic background in quantum mechanics. The central question is when classical descriptions suffice, and when the quantum states of matter or the field must be retained explicitly. Starting from familiar electromagnetic modes and material response, the discussion develops atomic dynamics, field quantization, and the interaction of quantized fields with quantum matter. Particular attention is given to how mode profiles, Green functions, and scattering matrices obtained from classical electromagnetic calculations enter quantum models. Atomic coherence, photon statistics, spontaneous emission, and cavity coupling are developed through derivations that identify the physical assumptions and limits of each description. Examples drawn from atomic clocks, Rydberg-atom receivers, and single-photon devices connect these concepts to excitation, propagation, and measurement in practical systems. Loss and noise are included in relating internal dynamics to measured signals and correlations. The final discussion examines how sensitivity and claims of quantum advantage depend on bandwidth, measurement resources, and the classical reference used for comparison. The aim is to help readers choose an appropriate model, carry out the calculation, and understand what its predictions mean for an electromagnetic measurement.

summaries.en: This book introduces quantum electromagnetics to readers with a classical electromagnetics background, explaining when classical descriptions suffice versus when quantum states of matter or field must be retained and how classical electromagnetic quantities such as mode profiles, Green functions, and scattering matrices enter quantum models.
summaries.zh: 本书面向具有经典电磁学背景的读者介绍量子电磁学，阐明何时经典描述足够、何时必须显式保留物质或场的量子态，以及模式分布、格林函数和散射矩阵等经典电磁计算结果如何进入量子模型。
summaries.ja: 本書は古典電磁気学の背景を持つ読者に量子電磁気学を導入し、古典的記述で十分な場合と物質や場の量子状態を明示的に保持すべき場合を説明するとともに、モード分布・グリーン関数・散乱行列といった古典電磁気計算の結果が量子モデルにどう取り込まれるかを示す。

title: Linear-optical generation of approximate higher-component cat states
abstract: We propose a method for generating higher-component cat states by interfering two $N$-component cat states on a half beam splitter and measuring one output with a photon-number-resolving detector. The Fock components of the conditional output are restricted to a single residue class modulo $2N$. For $N=3$, an ideal six-component cat state can be generated exactly, while for arbitrary $N$, the conditional output approaches an ideal $2N$-component cat state for sufficiently large input amplitudes.

summaries.en: Interfering two N-component cat states on a half beam splitter and performing photon-number-resolving detection on one output yields a conditional state whose Fock components are restricted to a single residue class modulo 2N, giving an exact six-component cat state for N=3 and approaching an ideal 2N-component cat state for large input amplitudes at arbitrary N.
summaries.zh: 通过在半束分束器上干涉两个N分量猫态并用光子数分辨探测器测量一路输出，所提出的方法可使条件输出态的Fock分量限制在模2N的单一剩余类中，在N=3时精确生成理想六分量猫态，而对任意N在输入振幅足够大时条件输出趋近于理想2N分量猫态。
summaries.ja: 2つのN成分猫状態をハーフビームスプリッターで干渉させ、一方の出力を光子数分解検出器で測定することにより、条件付き出力のフォック成分を2Nを法とする単一の剰余類に制限する手法が提案され、N=3では理想的な6成分猫状態が厳密に生成でき、任意のNでは入力振幅が十分大きいとき条件付き出力が理想的な2N成分猫状態に近づく。

title: Quantum phase estimation on a Rydberg quantum simulator
abstract: Determining the energy spectrum of a many-body quantum system is a central goal of quantum physics. Ground-state energies underpin materials science and quantum chemistry, whereas excited states govern dynamical phenomena such as quantum thermalization. Quantum simulators have greatly shaped our understanding of many-body systems, for example, by enabling access to microscopic mechanisms and nonlocal order parameters. However, experiments still struggle to access the full range of many-body spectral features and are typically limited to measuring energy gaps and excitations by spectroscopic means. Here, we address this challenge by demonstrating quantum phase estimation on an analog Rydberg quantum simulator. We reconstruct the complex-valued return amplitude, or Loschmidt echo, of an initial probe state. From its Fourier transform, we measure absolute ground-state energies and energy gaps in systems of up to 19 atoms in one and two spatial dimensions. Varying the initial probe state, we select distinct spectral windows within which we compute the longitudinal and transverse magnetization, and observe their competition across the many-body spectrum. Our results thereby demonstrate phase-sensitive many-body spectroscopy on an analog quantum simulator without auxiliary qubits or controlled evolution.

summaries.en: The authors demonstrate quantum phase estimation on an analog Rydberg quantum simulator by reconstructing the Loschmidt echo of a probe state, whose Fourier transform yields absolute ground-state energies, energy gaps, and selected spectral windows of magnetization in systems of up to 19 atoms in one and two dimensions.
summaries.zh: 作者在模拟Rydberg量子模拟器上演示了量子相位估计，通过重构探测态的Loschmidt回波并对其做傅里叶变换，在一维和二维最多19个原子的系统中测量了绝对基态能量、能隙以及选定谱窗内的磁化强度。
summaries.ja: 著者らはアナログRydberg量子シミュレータ上で量子位相推定を実証し、プローブ状態のLoschmidtエコーを再構成してそのフーリエ変換から、1次元および2次元の最大19原子系における絶対基底状態エネルギー、エネルギーギャップ、および選択したスペクトル窓内の磁化を測定した。

title: Number fluctuations and particle loss in Dicke superradiance
abstract: Dicke superradiance, the collective spontaneous emission of identical quantum emitters into a common reservoir, produces a burst with a characteristic delay $t_{\mathrm{SR}}$ and a peak intensity that scales quadratically with the emitter number $N$. This strong dependence makes the burst sensitive to how many emitters actually participate. In experiments, however, this number is rarely fixed: it fluctuates between preparations and decreases during emission through atom loss. Here we extend the analytical treatment of superradiance to variable emitter numbers using the Schwinger-boson mapping of the collective spin onto two bosonic modes. In this formulation, collective decay annihilates an atom in the excited-state mode and creates one in the ground-state mode. We find that number fluctuations enhance emission and that the ensemble-averaged emission trace encodes the initial number distribution. We show how to reconstruct second-order correlations from photon counting with finite detection efficiency and temporal resolution, even when the full distribution cannot be resolved. For atom loss at rate $r$, we derive exact results for the population dynamics and show that the peak intensity scaling is governed by the single scaling variable $g_{\mathrm{r}}=r t_{\mathrm{SR}}$. The peak remains quadratic in $N$ for $g_{\mathrm{r}}<1$, follows logarithmically corrected subquadratic power laws for $g_{\mathrm{r}}>1$, and crosses over to linear scaling under strong loss with $g_{\mathrm{r}}\gg1$.

summaries.en: Using a Schwinger-boson mapping of the collective spin, the authors show that emitter-number fluctuations enhance Dicke superradiance and that atom loss at rate r makes the peak-intensity scaling depend only on the single variable g_r = r t_SR, remaining quadratic in N for g_r < 1, becoming logarithmically corrected subquadratic for g_r > 1, and crossing over to linear scaling for g_r >> 1.
summaries.zh: 作者利用集体自旋的 Schwinger 玻色子映射，表明发射体数目的涨落会增强 Dicke 超辐射，并且以速率 r 发生的原子损耗使峰值强度的标度仅取决于单一变量 g_r = r t_SR：当 g_r < 1 时峰值仍随 N 二次增长，当 g_r > 1 时变为对数修正的次二次幂律，而在 g_r >> 1 的强损耗下过渡为线性标度。
summaries.ja: 著者らは集団スピンのSchwingerボソン写像を用いて、放出体数の揺らぎがDicke超放射を増強すること、および速度rの原子損失下でピーク強度のスケーリングが単一変数g_r = r t_SRのみで決まり、g_r < 1ではNについて二次のまま、g_r > 1では対数補正された準二次の冪則となり、g_r >> 1の強い損失では線形スケーリングへ移行することを示した。

title: Complex fluid flow dynamics by bright scattershot boson sampling
abstract: Boson sampling machines have become a fruitful tool for establishing new concepts, which connect fundamental physics with computer science applications. Here, we exploit the intrinsically high-dimensional correlations generated by the measurement outcomes of a multiphoton boson sampling machine and demonstrate how a reconfigurable architecture can be programmed to autonomously model the time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems that describe complex fluid flows. By extending on the original scattershot boson sampling (SBS) scheme to include higher photon number components -- a scheme which we label bright scattershot boson sampling (BSBS) --- this scheme overcomes scaling issues inherent to SBS-based schemes by utilizing all randomly generated input photon number distributions. We illustrate the capability of this scheme for two complex fluid-flow models: an eight-dimensional Lorenz-type model of two-dimensional thermally driven convection and a 16-dimensional model of global atmospheric circulation. Using a digital twin of the BSBS architecture based on multiphoton statistics, we show that the photonic approach accurately reproduces the temporal dynamics of both systems while being resilient to photon losses of up to 50 per cent. We also verified that the BSBS case outperforms a comparable run with coherent light. Moreover, its prediction horizon exceeds that of a classical reservoir-computing model with the same query complexity. These results highlight the potential of near-term photonic quantum computing for addressing relevant real-world tasks on noisy intermediate-scale devices.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Atmospheric and Oceanic Physics (physics.ao-ph); Fluid Dynamics (physics.flu-dyn)

summaries.en: A reconfigurable bright scattershot boson sampling architecture using multiphoton statistics can accurately model the time evolution of complex fluid-flow systems, including an eight-dimensional Lorenz-type convection model and a 16-dimensional global atmospheric circulation model, while tolerating up to 50% photon loss and outperforming coherent-light and comparable classical reservoir-computing approaches.
summaries.zh: 一种基于多光子统计的可重构明亮散粒玻色采样架构能够准确模拟复杂流体流动系统的时间演化，包括八维洛伦兹型对流模型和十六维全球大气环流模型，同时可容忍高达50%的光子损耗，并优于相干光方案及查询复杂度相同的经典储备池计算模型。
summaries.ja: 多光子統計に基づく再構成可能なブライト・スキャッターショット・ボソンサンプリング構造は、8次元のローレンツ型対流モデルや16次元の全球大気循環モデルを含む複雑な流体流れ系の時間発展を正確に再現し、最大50%の光子損失に耐えつつ、コヒーレント光や同等のクエリ計算量を持つ古典的リザバーコンピューティングを上回る性能を示す。

title: BeST: Beta splatted tomography for direct reconstruction from coherent imaging measurements
abstract: Conventional coherent X-ray tomography requires the phase of each projection to be reconstructed with high fidelity. However, individual reconstructed projections might be flawed, e.g. due to positioning errors, yielding inconsistent tomographic reconstructions. By directly coupling phase retrieval and tomography, consistency is enforced through a common object volume. But reconstructing a full volume demands substantial computational resources. To reduce this demand, we introduce Beta Splatted Tomography (BeST), which represents the common object volume using compactly supported beta primitives with closed-form analytical projections, enabling efficient reconstruction directly from coherent scattering images. This representation substantially reduces the number of optimizable parameters compared to a voxel grid. We demonstrate BeST on experimental datasets from hard X-ray near-field holography and far-field ptychography measurements. In both cases, the joint technique improves reconstruction quality compared to two-step methods.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Data Analysis, Statistics and Probability (physics.data-an)

summaries.en: BeST represents the common object volume using compactly supported beta primitives with closed-form analytical projections, enabling direct and efficient joint phase-retrieval and tomography from coherent X-ray imaging measurements with fewer optimizable parameters than a voxel grid.
summaries.zh: BeST利用具有闭式解析投影的紧支撑beta基元来表示公共物体体积，从而能够直接从相干X射线成像测量中高效地进行相位恢复与断层重建的联合重建，且可优化参数数量远少于体素网格。
summaries.ja: BeSTは閉形式の解析的投影を持つコンパクトサポートのベータプリミティブで共通物体体積を表現することで、ボクセルグリッドより少ない最適化パラメータでコヒーレントX線イメージング測定から位相回復とトモグラフィを直接かつ効率的に統合再構成する手法である。

title: Linear Dynamic Range Extension for Rydberg Atomic Receiver via Band-Limited Reconstruction
abstract: Rydberg-atom receiver offers a promising approach to radio-frequency (RF) signal reception in wireless communication and sensing systems, combining high sensitivity with the potential for broad frequency coverage. However, the limited linear dynamic range (LDR) of the atomic system causes nonlinear distortion at high input signal levels, thereby restricting the receiver's effective linear input range. To address this issue, we analyze the mechanisms underlying nonlinear distortion in Rydberg atomic receivers and propose a physics-informed band-limited iterative reconstruction (PI-BLIR) method. Specifically, by exploiting the known nonlinear atomic response and signal bandwidth prior, we formulate a constrained maximum-likelihood problem to reconstruct the distorted complex intermediate-frequency (IF) waveform. With the bandwidth constraint absorbed into the frequency-domain parameterization, the constrained maximum-likelihood problem is transformed into an unconstrained optimization problem, which is solved using gradient descent. The proposed method relies solely on digital post-processing and requires no changes to the local-oscillator (LO) field strength, optical parameters, or atomic operating conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that PI-BLIR extends the receiver's LDR by more than 14 dB and enhances the demodulation performance of the atomic receiver.

summaries.en: A physics-informed band-limited iterative reconstruction method extends the linear dynamic range of a Rydberg atomic receiver by more than 14 dB through digital post-processing alone, without altering the local-oscillator field, optical parameters, or atomic operating conditions.
summaries.zh: 一种基于物理信息的带限迭代重建方法仅通过数字后处理即可将里德堡原子接收机的线性动态范围扩展超过14 dB，而无需改变本振场强、光学参数或原子工作条件。
summaries.ja: 物理情報に基づく帯域制限反復再構成法は、局部発振場の強度、光学パラメータ、原子の動作条件を変更することなく、デジタル後処理のみによってリュードベリ原子受信機の線形ダイナミックレンジを14 dB以上拡張する。

title: How Robust are Pinching-Antenna Systems to Practical Deployment Imperfections?
abstract: This paper investigates the robustness of pinching-antenna systems (PASSs) to three practical deployment imperfections: pinching-antenna (PA) positioning errors, imperfect channel state information (CSI), and line-of-sight (LoS) blockages. We develop analytical frameworks to quantify the performance degradation caused by each imperfection. For PA positioning errors, we employ a Brownian meander model to characterize the distribution and mean of the resulting signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) loss. The results show that positioning errors can diminish the gains from long-term position selection, with the loss becoming more pronounced under stronger shadow fading. For imperfect CSI, we characterize the distribution and moments of the true scattered channel power at the position selected using noisy channel estimates. The resulting selection penalty is governed by the ratio of noise variance to the number of channel measurements, while the upper tail of the selected channel power retains the same behavior as under perfect CSI. Finally, we develop a spatially consistent blockage model and derive the distribution of the optimum long-term SNR for arbitrary blockage configurations, together with a numerically tractable expression for a single blockage. Simulation results validate the analyses and highlight a fundamental property of PASSs: although positioning errors and imperfect CSI can reduce the gains from position selection, good performance can still be achieved provided that an LoS link is available. In particular, even when a large proportion of the waveguide is blocked, PA repositioning can establish LoS links and enable performance close to that of a fully unblocked system for the considered configurations.

summaries.en: This paper analytically and numerically shows that, while pinching-antenna positioning errors and imperfect CSI reduce the gains from long-term position selection, pinching-antenna systems remain robust to these imperfections and to line-of-sight blockages as long as an LoS link is available, since repositioning can restore near-unblocked performance even when much of the waveguide is blocked.
summaries.zh: 本文通过分析和仿真表明，尽管夹持天线定位误差和不完美信道状态信息会削弱长期位置选择带来的增益，但只要存在视距链路，夹持天线系统对这些实际部署缺陷和视距阻塞仍具有鲁棒性，因为即使大部分波导被遮挡，重新定位夹持天线也能恢复接近无遮挡系统的性能。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ピンチングアンテナの位置誤差や不完全なCSIが長期的な位置選択の利得を減少させるものの、見通しリンクが存在する限りピンチングアンテナシステムはこれらの実装上の欠陥や見通し遮断に対して堅牢であり、導波路の大部分が遮断されても再配置によって遮断のないシステムに近い性能を回復できることを解析とシミュレーションで示している。

title: D2ToF: One-Step Diffusion for Depth Super-Resolution from Lightweight Single-Photon LiDAR Waveforms
abstract: Single-photon LiDAR (SPL) sensors offer exceptional temporal resolution and single-photon sensitivity for depth imaging. However, cost-effective SPL arrays typically suffer from extremely low spatial resolutions (e.g. $8\times 8$ pixels), limiting their real-world utility. In this paper, we propose a novel, one-step super-resolution framework, D2ToF, Distilled Diffusion for Time-of-Flight, that bridges the gap between high-fidelity generative modeling and real-time execution. Our approach uses an amortized variational distillation strategy that allows for a measurement-based data consistency term to be incorporated directly into the one-step training objective. This encourages that the synthesized high-resolution depth maps are consistent with the captured low-resolution Time-of-Flight (ToF) histograms. To overcome the severe ill-posedness of upsampling extremely degraded inputs, we introduce a multimodal guidance strategy. By leveraging a foundational monocular depth model to extract structural priors from a high-resolution reflectivity image, our network is guided by a rich triad of the ToF histogram, reflectivity map, and relative depth estimate. Experimental results outperform evaluated baselines, achieving $16\times$ spatial super-resolution (from $8\times 8 \times 100$ histograms to $128\times 128$ depth maps) at an accelerated inference speed of approximately $83$ milliseconds.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

summaries.en: D2ToF introduces a one-step distilled diffusion framework with multimodal guidance from ToF histograms, reflectivity images, and monocular depth priors to achieve fast 16x depth super-resolution from low-resolution single-photon LiDAR waveforms.
summaries.zh: D2ToF提出了一种单步蒸馏扩散框架，利用ToF直方图、反射率图像和单目深度先验的多模态引导，从低分辨率单光子LiDAR波形实现快速的16倍深度超分辨率。
summaries.ja: D2ToFは、ToFヒストグラム、反射率画像、単眼深度事前分布によるマルチモーダル誘導を用いた1ステップ蒸留拡散フレームワークにより、低解像度の単一光子LiDAR波形から高速な16倍の深度超解像を実現する。
